thesis: Regime unchanged: HBM/memory remains the binding constraint (KV-cache demand exploding, Huawei HBM bottleneck, memory prices surging). Power is the secondary bottleneck as GW-scale clusters (xAI Colossus 2, Meta multi-GW, Oracle $455B RPO) strain grid capacity. Deploying from 10% to 93% across all five layers — compute overweight at 28% reflects bottleneck severity; 7% cash retained for volatility
